    Sincere directing modules #

    Let U be a sincere directing module over a directed algebra. No tilting theory is used.

    • injE x, the indecomposable injective at x, as a space of functionals; every map into it is given by a functional (homToInj), so it is injective (injE_extend) and a brick (injE_brick).
    • A nonsplit extension of indecomposables gives a path (reach_of_nonsplit).
    • If W is a predecessor of U, the syzygy of W has no extensions at all (extVanish_syz_of_pred). This is the elementary part of "a sincere directing module makes the algebra tilted": projective dimension at most one for predecessors of U.
    • Vossieck's lemma (mono_or_epi): every nonzero morphism v : x → y with x ≠ y acts on U injectively or surjectively. Here the proof uses no Auslander–Reiten translate.
